note: One row per source. “latest_in_report” is the newest period the report actually uses; “next_expected” is the publisher’s next release (dates marked tentative or not announced where the publisher has not said).

sources.publisher: Title Guaranty of Hawaiʻi (private title company)
sources.title: Buyer Statistics (statewide, four island panels, district pages)
sources.geography: Statewide; Oʻahu, Maui County (incl. Molokaʻi, Lānaʻi), Kauaʻi, Hawaiʻi Island; 26 Title Guaranty districts
sources.metrics: Recorded sales by buyer residence (Hawaiʻi / other US / foreign); sales and dollars; top-10 buyer states and up to 5 countries per panel; district US TOTAL and FOREIGN TOTAL
sources.definitions: Buyer origin = address on the recorded documents; Title Guaranty does not publish its method. Other-US = US TOTAL minus Hawaiʻi row. Counts are recorded deeds, not MLS sales.
sources.cadence: Quarterly, cumulative year-to-date editions (Q1 Jan–Mar, Q2 Jan–Jun, Q3 Jan–Sep, Q4 full year)
sources.latest_in_report: Q2 2026 edition (Jan–Jun 2026; server Last-Modified 2026-08-31); full-year 2025 (Q4 2025 edition)
sources.next_expected: Q3 2026 edition (Jan–Sep 2026); not posted as of 2026-10-08; date not published
sources.reuse: Publication reads “All rights reserved; no reproduction without prior written consent.” Micah reports written permission received: keep it on file, credit Title Guaranty on every page, confirm scope covers web republication of tables.
sources.validation: District foot rows (US TOTAL + FOREIGN TOTAL) sum to island total; four islands sum to statewide; derived shares match printed pies within 0.5 pt; statewide state counts equal island sums where listed on all four panels; later editions restate earlier periods, so compare periods within the latest edition (e.g. 2024 restated 16,709 vs 16,716 originally).

sources.title: State of Hawaii Data Book 2025, Section 21, Tables 21.36–21.38 (home sales by type and by origin of buyer)
sources.metrics: Recorded single-family and condo sales and average prices by buyer origin, 2008–2025
sources.definitions: Source line: Title Guaranty of Hawaii, Inc., based on DLNR Bureau of Conveyances data; calculations by DBEDT. Origin categories as classified by Title Guaranty.
sources.next_expected: Data Book 2026 (2026 data), date not announced
sources.reuse: Public government data; cite DBEDT and the underlying Title Guaranty/BOC source.
sources.validation: County rows sum to statewide every year; count-weighted averages reproduce statewide averages within $1; 716 overlapping figures match an independent transcription; one Data Book typo (Honolulu 2019 local average) corrected to the QSER value. DBEDT 2024 count (18,007) runs ~8% above Title Guaranty’s own 2024 count (16,709/16,716): compare 2024 by share, not count.

sources.publisher: Internal Revenue Service, Statistics of Income
sources.title: County-to-county and state-to-state migration data, 2004–05 through 2022–23
sources.geography: Four Hawaiʻi counties × US counties; Hawaiʻi × states
sources.metrics: Tax returns (households), exemptions (people), AGI moving in and out
sources.definitions: Counts tax-filing households that changed address between filing years; not buyers or sellers. IRS changed method with 2011–12 (full-year filings, spouse/dependent matching); county pairs under 20 returns are suppressed (10 before 2013–14).
sources.cadence: Annual, roughly 2–3 years after the moves
sources.next_expected: 2023–24 data: IRS SOI public release schedule lists 2026-11-20 (tentative)
sources.reuse: Public domain (US federal).
sources.normalized: page_data.json keys irs, irs20, mig, corridors, state_corr, dest4; irs_instate.json
sources.validation: 2013–14 onward national files match SHA-256 of independent irs.gov downloads; earlier files came from a public mirror and were not independently checksummed (re-download from irs.gov is open future work). Only county pairs ≥20 in every year are compared; counts are lower bounds.

sources.title: HMDA Data Browser, 2025 and 2019 loan-level public data
sources.geography: Four counties; census tracts mapped to county subdivisions (2020 and 2010 tracts)
sources.metrics: Originated home-purchase loans (1–4 unit, site-built): occupancy type, loan type (VA etc.), applicant income, property value
sources.definitions: Occupancy 1 principal residence, 2 second residence, 3 investment. Covers financed purchases only (no cash). Second-home vs investment coding changed between 2019 and 2025, so only the combined non-principal share is compared.
sources.reuse: Public data.
sources.validation: County totals reconcile across hmda.json, hmda_tiers.json and hmda_tract.json in both years; 0 mismatches across 203 (2025) and 257 (2019) geography groups on independent recompute; cells under 20 loans flagged and not quoted as rates.

sources.publisher: City and County of Honolulu, Real Property Assessment
sources.title: OWNINFO / OWNDAT owner tables, ASMTPITT tax class, LEGDAT situs ZIP (ArcGIS services)
sources.geography: Oʻahu parcels (587,662 owner records; 270,163 residential parcels with a mailing address)
sources.metrics: Owner mailing-address location (Hawaiʻi / other US / foreign; state, metro, ZIP3); homeowner-exemption flag
sources.definitions: Mailing address = where the tax bill goes (may be a manager or trust). Addresses shared by 10+ parcels treated as institutional. Exemption status does NOT identify how a home is used.
sources.reuse: Owner mailing addresses are public records (OIP Op. Ltr. 11-01); portal terms for bulk/commercial reuse not verified. Publish aggregates only; never owner names, addresses or parcel IDs.
sources.validation: 23 independent checks passed; residential shares 91.2% Hawaiʻi / 7.6% other US / 1.0% foreign.
